finding: D02 requires existing Document commit machinery while broadly prohibiting callbacks under publication locks. Existing commit_impl calls validate_constraints, including leased Document::constrain validators, under the Document lock. Those public validators are documented as nonreentrant into the Document or controller.

decision.forbidden_during_locked_publication: ExecutionControl, cancellation/progress, UI, workflow and caller preparation callbacks. Capture caller-owned values before those callbacks; execute them outside Application/Document publication locks.
decision.preserved_existing_exception: Existing leased DocumentValidator capability/thread validators retain their current nonreentrant contract and execution inside commit_impl before mutation. Their rejection leaves document/history/publication unchanged. Do not bypass them, relocate them into an unlock/check/relock window, or introduce a new generic under-lock validation callback.
decision.guard_implementation: Use the adopted narrow typed saved-row guard inside the same commit lock and existing Application-to-Document lock order. Final owner/activation/Data/row/TCZ and optional Pointer Display checks remain atomic with mutation.
decision.superseded_scope: Only the blanket no-user-callback-under-lock wording in D02 is narrowed for the already-existing Document::constrain validators. All other D01-D03 behavior, resource limits, ownership and membership remain unchanged.

assertion_placement: Refine existing N14.callback_owned_capture_exception_midcancel to distinguish forbidden preparation callbacks from existing constraints and prove a rejecting retained constraint cannot be bypassed or partially publish. Keep exact 16/12/5/8/20 memberships; this adds no accepted observation.
